document.abstract: his paper describes a two-position console developed to handle mltitrack rerecording requirements using sliding volume controls and preset equalization with which the mixer has at his command combinations of equalizers that may be connected into the circuit upon cue as required. Also a variable-type attenuation equalizer circuit, arranged to give improved equalization characteristics as the control dial is varied from step to step, is discussed.
